remarks:
Exquisite executive estate property nestled on 1.67 acres and over 6,400 sq feet.
From its fabulous floor plan and fine finishes to the glorious grounds, Gunite in-ground pool, fire pit, stone walls and walkways. This is that spectacular home that lends itself to elegant and effortless entertaining in every season. Over 4,500 sq ft of step-free first-floor living includes a stunning primary suite with walls of windows, his/her California closets, hidden makeup room, and a luxury zero-step shower featuring 14 Kohler water tiles, dual zones, and Mr. Steam system. Private deck access off the suite.
Glass-enclosed sunroom offers panoramic views of the yard and pool, plus wet bar, dishwasher, and beverage chiller. Chef’s kitchen features a 48” Wolf dual-fuel range, Sub-Zero designer refrigerator/freezer, with a graceful transition into the great room and sunroom, creating an exceptional environment for sophisticated entertaining.
Additional first-floor amenities include a large laundry room with tiled dog wash/kennel and direct outdoor access. Second floor offers an additional primary suite, two more en-suite bedrooms, and a loft/fitness area.
Four-zone Lennox HVAC with air filtration and Aprilaire humidifiers, whole-house water filtration, dual brand-new Navien tankless systems, 400-amp electric service, dedicated AV subpanel, and Generac Elite natural-gas generator.
Two garages: original 2-car with hot/cold hose bib and drain, plus newer garage with removable wheelchair ramp. A rare combination of acreage, accessibility, luxury amenities, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living.
